description: This file contains helper functions and tests related to terminal output, specifically for testing terminal capabilities and prerequisites in shell scripts. It includes functions like 'test_terminal' and 'test_lazy_prereq' that perform prerequisite checks and run Perl test scripts, with commentary on issues with terminal I/O on different platforms.

methods.name: test_terminal
methods.description: Checks if the TTY prerequisite is declared; if so, runs a Perl test script for terminal testing.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: Sets up lazy prerequisite check for TTY, executing a Perl script to test terminal I/O behavior.
